verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents VM-based isolation, with each sandbox in its own VM or container, for running untrusted code securely. That implies host secrets are not shared with sandboxed code, but the docs never explicitly say that host credentials or secrets are unreachable. Outbound HTTP can be intercepted by Workers, though the pack doesn't describe this as credential protection. missing for 10: explicit documentation that host or Worker secrets are never exposed to sandboxed code, a documented secret-injection or credential-brokering mechanism, and independent hands-on verification of secret isolation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can give an agent a sandbox where host secrets and credentials are unreachable by the code it runs

citations.quote: VM-based isolation - Each sandbox runs in its own VM
The Sandbox SDK enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments.
Each sandbox runs in its own isolated container with a full Linux environment, providing strong security boundaries while maintaining performance.
